newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi Corp says in no financial trouble.
newsitem.headline: Sammi Corp says in no financial trouble.

text.p: An executive of Sammi Corp on Thursday denied rumours on the stock market that the company faced financial trouble.
"It's true that we missed the first deadline for debt repayments two days ago, but we were able to make up for it the very next day," the executive, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.
"For now, we have no trouble at all," he said.
He declined to give more details.
Shares of Sammi and its sister company Sammi Steel Co Ltd fell their daily limits in early Thursday trading on the rumours.
Sammi was down 170 won to 2,040 and Sammi Steel fell 320 won to 3,700.
